license_or_terms: Public EIA data; see EIA terms of use.
source_scope: Form EIA-860 reporting plants and generator records. The EIA early-release notice says these files are not fully edited, may exclude records pending validation, and are inappropriate for aggregation.
coordinate_scope: Schedule 2 reports plant latitude and longitude. Schedule 3.1 generator and 3.4 storage records attach to plant IDs but do not provide unit coordinates, terminals, network edges, or facility polygons.
